
---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}

Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    player_name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    active_steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(player_name, career_home_runs),
    fill = active_steroid_era
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Career overlapped 1994–2009",
    values = c("Yes" = "#0072B2", "No" = "gray60")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman package, Batting and People data"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sluggers

Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )

```
